name: r6-auth-uuid-scoped
description: users.user_uuid as BLOB, empty BLOB, empty TEXT, integer and real (stored as text), and TEXT/BLOB twins with the same bytes. Node binds a Buffer back as a BLOB, so scope reads find the BLOB row and BLOB grants only; a Buffer is truthy. Record with --scoped.

steps.why: owner of zones granted to the probe accounts
user_uuid CAST('u-twin' AS BLOB) with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
user_uuid CAST('u-twin2' AS BLOB) with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
user_uuid 'u-twin3' with a twin row holding the same bytes in the other storage class
